name: sol_integrations_layerzero_3
description: Inaccurate/hardcoded gas estimation for LayerZero cross-chain messages causing message execution failures
question: The source file in `source` sends LayerZero cross-chain messages (e.g., via _lzSend, lzSend, or endpoint.send) using a hardcoded or unadjustable gas limit for destination execution, without calling estimateFees/quote or providing any per-chain or caller-configurable gas parameter, so that lzReceive execution on the destination chain can run out of gas and the message can fail or be stuck; this excludes implementations that dynamically compute or allow admin/caller configuration of the gas limit per destination chain, or that call an estimation function before dispatching the message.
criteria: _lzSend() encodes adapterParams with a hardcoded gas limit constant instead of using an estimateFees() call or caller-supplied value
sendMessage() applies a single fixed gas limit for lzReceive execution across all destination chains with no per-chain configuration
The contract submits cross-chain messages via _lzSend without first calling estimateFees or quote to compute the required destination gas/fees
A hardcoded gas value is passed directly into the LayerZero adapter parameters with no owner-settable function to adjust it after deployment
